description: why-not-what：单向沟通只记录「为什么」，不复述「做了什么」——注释、README、提交信息。 Use when the user asks to write, polish, or rewrite comments, a commit message, a README, or a PR description; wants code decisions explained for future readers; or when code-review or contributing-upstream needs the commit-hygiene contract. 触发于「帮我写提交信息/注释/README/PR 描述」或补全改动动机。
